notes: Singapore rules are national; no region is needed.

items.name: Annual General Meeting (AGM)
items.rule: Within 6 months after financial year end
items.applies: Private companies (unless dispensed with by shareholders, or financial statements are sent within 5 months)
items.description: Financial statements are laid before shareholders at the AGM; private companies can dispense with AGMs by resolution.
items.authority: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), Companies Act 1967 s.175

items.name: Annual Return to ACRA (with XBRL financial statements)
items.rule: Within 7 months after financial year end
items.applies: Private companies (exempt private companies may file a simplified version)
items.description: Filed on BizFile+ with the financial statements (XBRL where required); late filing attracts penalties.
items.authority: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), Companies Act 1967 s.197

items.name: Estimated Chargeable Income (ECI)
items.rule: Within 3 months after financial year end
items.applies: Companies (not required if annual revenue is S$5 million or less and ECI is nil)
items.description: An estimate of taxable income for the year of assessment; filing early allows payment by instalments.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form C-S / C-S (Lite) / C)
items.rule: 30 November each year (for the year of assessment)
items.description: Filed online through myTax Portal; the form depends on revenue and complexity.

items.name: Registers of Registrable Controllers and Nominee Directors
items.rule: Keep current; lodge updates on ACRA's central register within 2 business days of updating the company's register
items.applies: Companies, LLPs and foreign company branches
items.description: Controllers are asked to confirm their particulars and changes are recorded promptly.

items.name: Foreign Company Annual Return with Head Office and Branch Accounts
items.rule: Within 60 days after the foreign company's AGM (or within the extended period ACRA allows)
items.description: Both the foreign company's and the Singapore branch's financial statements are lodged each year.

items.name: LLP Annual Declaration of Solvency or Insolvency
items.rule: At least once each calendar year, no more than 15 months after the previous declaration
items.description: Partners declare whether the LLP is able to pay its debts as they fall due.
items.authority: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA), Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2005

items.name: Partnership Income Tax Return (Form P)
items.description: The precedent partner reports the partnership's income; each partner then reports their share on Form B.

items.name: Individual Income Tax Return (Form B)
items.description: Business income is declared on Form B with the 4-line statement or certified accounts.

items.name: Business Registration Renewal
items.rule: Before the registration expires (every 1 or 3 years, renewable up to 60 days early)
items.description: Renewal requires any outstanding MediSave contributions to be paid or on an instalment plan.

items.name: GST Registration
items.rule: Within 30 days once taxable turnover exceeded S$1 million in a calendar year, or is expected to in the next 12 months
items.description: Voluntary registration is possible below the threshold.

items.name: GST Return (GST F5) and Payment
items.rule: 1 month after the end of each quarterly accounting period
items.description: Returns are filed electronically, even for periods with no transactions.

items.name: GST Return (GST F5) and Payment (monthly)
items.rule: 1 month after the end of each monthly accounting period
items.description: Returns are filed electronically, even for periods with no transactions.

items.name: CPF Contributions and Skills Development Levy
items.rule: By the 14th of the following month
items.applies: Employers (CPF for Singapore citizens and PRs; SDL for all employees)
items.description: Employer and employee CPF contributions plus the Skills Development Levy are paid monthly; late payment attracts interest.

items.name: Employment Income Records (IR8A / AIS)
items.description: Employee income is submitted to IRAS under the Auto-Inclusion Scheme.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Documentation
items.rule: Prepared by the Form C filing due date (30 November)
items.applies: Companies with gross revenue over S$10 million and related-party transactions above the thresholds
items.description: Contemporaneous documentation must exist by the filing date; companies with related-party transactions over S$15 million also file the Form for Reporting Related Party Transactions.
